[AMOREPACIFIC] 2024 Entry-Level Recruitment_Foreign Applicants (~9/23)
■ Application period : ~ September 23(Mon) 2024, 11:59 PM(KST)
■ Apply
- Online application through Amorepacific recruitment website( https://m.site.naver. com/1sKqu )
- Sign Up → JOB APPLY → Open Jobs → Select position and Apply → Update My Profile
- If you already registered your application in the other existing talent pool, click modify and then apply.
■ Recruiting section : Global Sales, Global Marketing
■ Qualifications
- Graduates with a Bachelor’s degree or higher, or scheduled to graduate by February 2025
※ Applicants with no restrictions on 6 months full-time internship during January ~ June, 2025
※ D-2/D-10/E-7/F-2/F-4/F-5/F-6 visa holders can also apply
※ Internship is conducted under D-10 visa, and E-7 visia will be supported when transition to a permanent employee.
- Applicants who have no reason for disqualification for overseas travel or health
(in case of a man, who has completed or exempted from military service)
- GPA : No credit restrictions
- TOPIK(Korean Language Proficiency Test) Level 4 submission
Korean language grades must be submitted.
Other language grades submission is not necessary.
- Other second language grades are also given preferential treatment
■ Recruitment process
Document Screening > 1st Interview > Full-time Internship(6 months) >
Culture-Fit Interview / 2nd Interview > Final announcement

Q. Should I include a detailed research proposal in the Study Plan?
A. Yes. You must at least describe the general direction and outlines of your study plans, if not in
full detail. Please elaborate on your study objectives in Korea, tangible plans during and after
you complete the degree program.
Q. I am planning to apply through a university track. Can I submit my application to
multiple universities?
A. University track applicants can only apply to one university and one department. If an
applicant is found to have applied to more than two universities, his/her application document
will be excluded from the next round of evaluation. Even after the announcement of qualified
applicants, scholarships may be cancelled.
Embassy track applicants whose application have not passed the first round may apply to a
university track once more. However, applicants cannot apply for both tracks at once.
Q. My name on my birth certificate is different from the one on my graduation certificate.
What should I do when the names are different on the documents?
A. Applicant must apply with the name on their passport. If the name on your passport is
different from other documents, please provide a supplementary document issued by your
government that explains the discrepancy.
Q. How will I know if I have passed each assessment?
A. Result of the first round of selection will be announced by each embassy and university.

Mathematics: Foundational topics preparing students for Engineering Mathematics and Calculus at the freshman level of the College of Engineering.

passages.section: Job Announcement: Invitation for Instructors to Teach Mathematics in English
passages.text:
The Hanyang University Institute of International Education is seeking instructors to teach foundation-level Mathematics in English for government-sponsored students from the United Arab Emirates (UAE).
1. Student Information
Number of students: 6
All students are UAE nationals who have graduated from high school with excellent academic records as government scholarship recipients.
They are currently enrolled in the Korean Language Program at the Hanyang University Institute of International Education.
2. Course Content
Mathematics: Foundational topics preparing students for Engineering Mathematics and Calculus at the freshman level of the College of Engineering.
3. Teaching Period and Schedule
Periods: September 8, 2025 (Mon) – November 21, 2025 (Fri) (excluding the Chuseok holiday)
Schedule: 3 days per week, 14:00 – 17:00 (3 hours × 3 times per week × 10 weeks = total 90 hours)
4. Venue
Lecture room, International Building (Graduate School / Civil Engineering Building), Hanyang University Seoul Campus
5. Compensation
KRW 120,000 per hour
This program corresponds to the Fall 2025 semester. It will also be offered in the Winter semester (Dec 2025 – Feb 2026) and Spring semester (Mar – May 2026), each lasting 10 weeks. Based on the results of the Fall semester teaching evaluation, instructors may be invited to continue in the Winter and Spring semesters.
6. Qualifications
Applicants must be majoring in a science or engineering field (Master‘s degree or higher), and able to teach Mathematics in English.
